messages:
sam: main is red after the merge in #main — failing job `integration/prefix-cache-smoke`.
sam: saw it immediately after merging PR 4821 (sha: a1b2c3d) — logs show a segfault in the runtime during kv-cache init.
ci-bot: CI job <https://ci.internal.redwood/17890|integration/prefix-cache-smoke #17890> failed: exit status 139. Flake detection: 0.8 probability of regression.
maya: ack, pinging owners. @nora @lee any idea if your recent changes touched KV cache init paths?
nora: I didn't touch that code directly but my PR added a spine to the init ordering which could affect startup. looking.
lee: I added a small change to memory config for GPU warmup in the same area — could be related. I'll grab the logs.
devops: can someone rerun the job with DEBUG env and full core dumps enabled? `ci rerun --job 17890 --env DEBUG=1 --collect-core` should do it.
sam: can we quickly revert PR 4821 if this is blocking main? we don't have a hotfix yet.
maya: let's not revert yet — try a rerun first to confirm it's reproducible.
lee: rerun triggered by @lee -> <https://ci.internal.redwood/17892|integration/prefix-cache-smoke #17892> started.
ci-bot: Job 17892 failed again. Crash in same callstack: `runtime/kv_cache.c:init_cache+0x24`.
nora: same stack, reproducible on CI. I'll start a local bisect to find the exact offending commit between the last green and current.
lee: adding a short-term mitig: I'll push a patch to guard null pointer during init, but won't merge without review. creating PR now.
maya: thanks. @oncall-bot please escalate to infra oncall if this blocks deploys. :warning:
oncall-bot: Assigned to @devops for oncall rotation. Pager sent.
devops: looking at the dump — it's a use-after-free in the allocator on GPU warmup. suspecting the memory config tweak. nora, can you test reverting your ordering change locally with the GPU warmup turned on?
nora: running a local reproduce with docker image `redwood/inference:main-e2e` and warmup enabled, will report in ~15m.
sam: if revert proves quick, let's prepare a revert PR and mark it for fast-track. if not, merge the guard from lee and run extended canary.
lee: PR up: #4850 with the guard and test added. cc: @maya for quick review.
maya: reviewing now — will approve if tests pass. also adding `canary=false` to avoid immediate rollout until we confirm.
sam: good plan. keep updates here. thanks for the quick triage everyone :thumbsup:
